name: davidshaevel-claude-toolkit
description: Personal development conventions, skills, and project templates for Claude Code and Codex CLI

interface.shortDescription: Personal dev conventions, skills, and templates for Claude Code and Codex
interface.longDescription: Loads David Shaevel's development conventions at session start and provides skills for session handoff (cross-agent SESSION_LOG.md memory), local-config backup to Google Drive, PR code-review resolution, and project bootstrap. (The self-hosted-review skill is Claude Code-only — it requires subagent dispatch and is not executable under Codex CLI.) Works across Claude Code and Codex CLI.
